question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Cluster
solution:
The correct answer is: **Individual**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• **Cluster **means a group of things or people that are close together. (झुंड)

 
 
• **Example**: *A cluster of colorful flowers adorned the garden.*
 
 
 
• **Individual **means a single person or thing. (व्यक्तिगत)
 
 
• **Example**: *Each individual student received a certificate for their achievements.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of cluster is individual as it represents the opposite meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Consort **means a spouse or partner. (बातचीत करना)
 
• **Group **is a collection of people or things. (समूह)
 
• **Special **means better, greater, or otherwise different from what is usual. (विशेष)
